points.description: States that storage is a function of inflow and outflow discharge only (storage determined from inflow/outflow using the continuity equation).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says storage depends on discharge vaguely, without inflow and outflow.

points.description: States that the parameters K (and the weighting factor/exponent n) remain constant for the reach (until channel slope/conditions change), and that K depends on the travel time of the flood wave through the reach.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of these (constant K and n, or K related to travel time of flood wave) is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for stating both ideas: storage depends only on inflow and outflow discharge, and K and n are constant for the reach with K linked to flood-wave travel time. Give 1 mark total if only one idea is stated or the ideas are vague. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong assumptions; accept clear synonyms such as "time of travel" for "line of travel".
